purpose: prove in staging that the release candidate works end to end and is fit to be approved for production
entry_criteria: Staging deployment of the candidate is complete (stage 130)
Test data and test accounts are available
Acceptance criteria for the release are written
procedure: Run the regression suite and critical-journey tests against staging and record results.
Verify the acceptance criteria for each change in the release with the product owner or their delegate.
Check non-functional results: performance against objectives, security scan status, accessibility where in scope.
Review open defects; each is fixed, accepted by its owner or blocks the release.
Record PASS, FAIL or CONDITIONAL with evidence for each area.
Hand the record to release readiness (stage 128).
acceptance_criteria: Every change in the release has acceptance evidence
Open defects are fixed, accepted or blocking
Report is tied to the candidate digest
validation_method: QA lead sign-off on the report.

validation.check: compare the digest in the report with the one deployed to staging

failure_modes.mode: Acceptance not checked for a change
failure_modes.detection: No evidence for a listed change

failure_modes.response: Add and have its owner decide

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: All critical journeys pass on staging. One cosmetic defect is accepted by the product owner for the next release; the recommendation is GO.
